parts.text: At 30 mph, below the 45 mph threshold, the taper length is the offset width times the speed squared, divided by 60.
Buffer space is the longitudinal clear distance between traffic and workers, sized for stopping sight distance at the posted speed.
MUTCD Table 6B-2 sets 200 ft; the CDOT supplement sets no value at this speed.
In the taper, devices are spaced 30 ft apart, the speed in feet at 30 mph (MUTCD Sec 6K.01).
Along the tangent, devices are spaced 60 ft apart, twice the speed in feet (MUTCD Sec 6K.01).
Cones in all (18 tangent, 3 buffer, 2 downstream)
At 30 mph, the signs are spaced by MUTCD Table 6B-1's Urban (low speed) row.

Table 6B-1 spacing: A 100 ft (the distance from the transition or point of restriction to the first sign), B 100 ft (the distance between the first and second signs), C 100 ft (the distance between the second and third signs).
Source: MUTCD § 6H.02 · Table 6B-1 · Advance warning sign spacing
